rationale: Build on the best recurrent-tail/export path by reallocating a small extra fp16 budget to `attn.c_v.weight` across all recurrent tail blocks instead of only the last block. Local close misses suggest recurrent-tail float rescue is still live, and preserving V on every repeated tail block is a compact export-aligned change that directly targets final int8+zlib behavior.
title: Recurrent Tail V FP16 Keep Expansion
